name: Call Christmas Tree Butterfly (1-3-2)
summary: Four contracts across three call strikes in a 1-3-2 ratio - buy 1 lower, sell 3 middle, buy 2 upper - giving a butterfly-like tent with capped, often zero, risk above the top strike.

legs.strike_rule: strike A: at or just ITM (~0.55 delta)
strike B = A + W (W = 1 strike increment x 2-4; B sits near the expected-move target)
strike C = B + W/2 (upper wing placed so the ratio 1-3-2 nets to zero delta above C)

max_profit: at strike B: (B - A) x 100 minus net debit (or plus net credit)
max_loss: downside: the net debit (zero if opened for a credit). Upside above C: (3 x (C - B)) - (C - A) ... in practice structure the ratio so upside risk is zero or capped; verify numerically before routing
breakevens: lower BE = A + net debit per share; upper BE depends on the exact 1-3-2 geometry - compute it explicitly at entry and store it

greeks.delta: positive at entry (~+0.15 to +0.30 per unit)
greeks.theta: positive when spot is below B

when_to_use: Moderately bullish with a specific price target at strike B, IV rank >= 30, and a skew that makes the 3x short strike rich. Chosen over a plain butterfly when you want a cheaper or credit entry and can accept the ratio geometry.
entry_rules: Strike B set at a concrete target: the 20-day high, a measured move, or spot x (1 + 0.75 x expected move)
Compute the full payoff numerically before routing; REJECT if upside risk above C is unbounded or exceeds 1.5% of equity
Net debit <= 25% of (B - A), or a net credit

Alpaca level 3 ONLY if every short is fully covered by a long at an equal-or-better strike in the same ratio; if the 3x short is not fully covered, the structure requires level 4 - check leg-by-leg coverage before submitting
Alpaca mleg orders support at most 4 legs; a 1-3-2 is 3 leg lines (ratios 1/3/2) and is acceptable
management_rules: Take profit at 50% of max profit
Close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L
Loss stop: close if the loss reaches 1.0x the net debit (or, for a credit entry, 2x the credit)
If spot exceeds strike B by more than 0.5 x (C - B), close - the position is past its tent and the ratio risk is the live exposure
Never let the trade approach expiry with spot between B and C
exit_rules: Force-close by 15:45 ET on expiration day, always
Close immediately if the 3x short strike B is ITM by more than 0.25 x (C - B), or its extrinsic < $0.10, or its delta >= 0.85
Ex-dividend guard: 3 short calls per unit means 300 shares of assignment exposure per unit; close before the ex-date if extrinsic < dividend
If any long leg goes illiquid, close the shorts first
assignment_risk: Three short calls per unit - the largest short-share exposure in this bank per unit of structure (300 shares). Assignment while the longs are held creates a large short stock position. The pre-expiry close is mandatory, not optional.
buying_power: Broker-computed; roughly the maximum modeled loss of the structure if fully covered. If Alpaca treats any short as uncovered, buying power jumps and the order will be rejected at level 3.
liquidity_needs: OI >= 500 at all three strikes; the 3x short strike must be very liquid because closing it is 3 contracts per unit.
common_mistakes: Routing without computing the payoff numerically; assuming 1-3-2 always has zero upside risk (it depends on the strike spacing); being assigned on 300 shares because it was treated like a normal butterfly.
zero_dte_notes: Not recommended: 3 short calls with 0DTE gamma and near-certain ITM assignment risk if spot sits above B into the close.
family: four-leg structures (iron condors, iron butterflies, condors, double calendars/diagonals, boxes, jelly rolls, conversions/reversals, double verticals, double ratio spreads)
